question: Which of the following spring festivals is celebrated in Goa?
solution:
The correct answer is __** Shigmo.**__

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Shigmo is a spring festival celebrated in the Indian state of Goa.**
 
• It is also known as **Shigmotsav and is celebrated in the month of Phalguna, which falls between February and March.**
 
• Shigmo is a Hindu festival that celebrates the arrival of spring and the victory of good over evil.
 
• The festival is marked by colorful **processions, folk dances, and musical performances.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 2: Mim Kut**

 
 
• Mim Kut is a harvest festival celebrated by the Mizos, a tribe in the northeastern state of Mizoram.
 
• It is celebrated in August or September to give thanks for a bountiful harvest.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Losar**
 
 
• Losar is a Tibetan festival that marks the beginning of a new year.
 
• It is celebrated in February or March and is a time for families to gather, eat traditional foods, and perform religious rituals
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Rouf**
 
 
• Rouf is a folk dance that originated in the Kashmir Valley in northern India.
 
• It is performed during the harvest season and is a celebration of the beauty of nature.
